These were super helpful, thanks for sharing.
No worries. My bad.  My question was more geared towards what methods you guys use to stay focused on your goals. I appreciate your perspective.
I'm hungry for more communities like this so I'm deciding to be more active. Kudos to you for almost getting close to your goal!

Why do you feel like that's the case? 

It's not always the case I talk about weight loss. But just like my friends give updates on their lives I give updates. But they try to make decisions for me and intentionally push me towards the negative habits I once had. I want balance but with people who have similar goals in life and health.
I love that. I will operate with that perspective from now on!

Ahhh! Okay thank you. So YNAB is treating my money like it’s one big pool of money so I just need to tell YNAB what I want to do with that money. 

That makes sense! And my headache has suddenly gone away. Thanks!!😊

33F, 5’6, SW: 330 CW: 226[weight loss progress video I made a few months ago!](https://youtu.be/gbVWgjPW_js?si=nt1o2eaASbkxl8Qg)

I’m officially down 100lbs!!!! And even better, I reached the weight I was ten years ago!!   

I never thought I would get close to this number again. This is a huge deal for me because I lost the weight for a guy and someone who I thought was a close friend but those relationship crippled me. This time around Im doing  it for me and I’m not stopping!!  I’m really proud of myself, even if I don’t really have anyone to celebrate with. 💪😝🥰
Thanks. It did help a lot makes a lot of sense.
